target.value: Arabic versions of EASO Access to Procedure toolkit, IPSN tool, Vulnerability Assessment tool and/or Referral tool and other relevant EUAA tools (ongoing- see list of translations provided above), Printed Arabic version of Access to Procedure toolkit and other relevant EUAA tools, Joint plan for the sustainable delivery of local level operational trainings/workshops on the use of the Access to Procedure, IPSN, Vulnerability Assessment and/or Referral tools (ongoing via regular consultations with EG MFA), EUAA support/advise to NCCM task force is delivered (e.g. advice in SOPs/referral mechanism drafting, TBD based on EG needs (to be delivered in Q3-Q3/2022)

actual.value: 1 June 2021: Presentation of the EASO Access to procedure toolkit and IPSN tools (online) with participation from Frontex. A total of 10 EG participants connected from MFA, MoJ, MoI, MoPA, AG Office, ACA, NCHR and NCCM. No evaluation form was received after the seminar despite several reminders. 29-30 November 2021: EASO national roll-out on Access to Procedures Toolkit and EASO Tools on the identification, assessment and referral of persons with special needs, Hilton Heliopolis, Cairo Egypt. Following a first presentation of EASO Access to Procedures (AtP) toolkit and the EASO tools on the identification, assessment and referral of persons with special needs delivered to EG officials from MFA, MoJ, MoD, MoI, NCCM and the NCHR on 1 June 2021 (online) and on 11-12 July 2021 in Sharm el Sheikh, EASO agreed with EG MFA to organize two national roll-outs within the framework and time frame of the EUAA-Egypt Roadmap and targeting first responders, including NGO organizations
